home.title: Research, Culture & Innovation
home.subtitle: MIRIT connects knowledge, cultures and technology to create meaningful experiences, research and practical digital solutions across borders.
home.perspectiveText: We work where research, culture and technology meet — making space for people and ideas to move forward together.
home.pathsIntro: Programs and practical work that turn curiosity into meaningful exchange.
home.pathOneText: A living exchange shaped with local communities, students and professionals.
home.pathTwoText: Research, experiences and tools designed for real human connection.
home.closingTitle: Curiosity is where every meaningful project begins.

about.title: A place for ideas to meet, move and become useful.
about.intro: MIRIT connects knowledge, cultures and technology to create meaningful experiences and practical possibilities across borders.
about.storyTitle: Curiosity becomes more powerful when it is shared.
about.storyTextOne: MIRIT is an evolving platform for exchange. We bring people, perspectives and disciplines into conversation — because lasting ideas rarely arrive from a single place.
about.storyTextTwo: Our work is grounded in listening, research and meaningful collaboration. We look for the practical next step: a programme, a connection, a tool or a shared experience that can create real momentum.
about.principlesIntro: Three directions that shape how MIRIT thinks, works and grows.

knowledge.title: Knowledge, shared
knowledge.text: We make research approachable, exchangeable and connected to the questions people are asking now.

culture.title: Culture, in dialogue
culture.text: We see cultural exchange as a living practice: built with care, context and respect for every voice involved.

innovation.title: Innovation, with purpose
innovation.text: We use technology when it helps people connect, learn or act — never simply for the sake of novelty.

about.closingTitle: Good things begin when perspectives come together.

contact.title: Start with a conversation.
contact.intro: Have an idea, a question or a possible collaboration? We would love to hear where it could lead.
contact.formIntro: A few words are enough. We will get back to you as soon as we can.
